title: Canadian Crew of Wellington Bomber
memorial_details:
description: Ornate wooden lectern standing on a octagonal pedestal and column with decorated, carved back and sides.  The sloping face has the  dedication incised in capital letters.

Black, slate tablet with side elevation of Wellington bomber at mid centre and RCAF and RAF badges left and right lower corners,

NB: The names of the crew are are also listed on memorial 15046
